title: Image charge location
description: Essential: Student correctly states the image charge is inside the sphere at a distance x = R²/L from the center.

title: Image charge magnitude
description: Essential: Student correctly states the image charge value is q₀ = -qR/L.

title: Force expression
description: Essential: Student provides the final force of attraction, F = (1/(4πε₀)) * (q²R/L) / (L - R²/L)².

title: Boundary condition application
description: Important: Student applies the constant-potential (V=0) condition on the sphere's surface using superposition.

title: Angle independence reasoning
description: Important: Student derives or states the condition (L²+R²)/L = (x²+R²)/x to make the potential independent of θ.

title: Coulomb's law for force
description: Important: Student calculates the force between the real charge and the image charge using Coulomb's law.

title: Sign error in charge
description: Pitfall: Student makes a sign error, giving a positive image charge or an incorrect sign in the force.

title: Distance error for force
description: Pitfall: Student uses an incorrect distance (e.g., L or L - x) in the Coulomb force calculation.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student shows dimensional analysis or unit consistency in the final force expression.
